name: Kenzo Furukawa
source: Kenzo’s existence is a result of improbable circumstances. Artificially grown after the collapse, he was raised by Acine, an assistant AI, deep underground in a place called CELL. Never interacted with humans, not sure if there's any left, he is definitely not okay.
